steps.en: Install the compiler with npm and write a normal typed TypeScript file
steps.zh: 用 npm 装好编译器，照常写有类型的 TS 文件

steps.en: Ask for a standalone executable instead of running it on Node
steps.zh: 不跑在 Node 上，直接要一个独立可执行文件

steps.en: The real tsc type-checks the program and lowers it to typed IR
steps.zh: 真正的 tsc 做类型检查，AST 降成带类型 IR

steps.en: The bundled LLVM helper emits assembly and object code from that IR
steps.zh: 自带的 LLVM 助手把 IR 编成汇编和目标文件

steps.en: The platform linker joins the object with the precompiled runtime pack; no C is compiled
steps.zh: 平台链接器把目标文件和预编译运行时包拼起来，全程不编译任何 C 代码

steps.en: Run and ship the binary — it needs no Node and no JS engine
steps.zh: 直接运行和分发这个二进制——目标机器不需要 Node，也没有 JS 引擎

value.en: A ~320KB native binary that starts in milliseconds — no Node install, no engine, no node_modules on the target
value.zh: 约 320KB 的原生二进制，毫秒级启动——目标机器不用装 Node、不带引擎、不需要 node_modules

sources: README Installation (npm install -g scriptc; Node.js 24 or newer; clang only the platform linker driver)
README Build a program (scriptc build hello.ts -o hello; ./hello ctate)
docs how-it-works (tsc parses and type-checks, lowering to typed IR; LLVM 22 helper emits assembly/object; precompiled runtime pack + linker; no program or runtime C compiled)
docs introduction (~320KB size class, no Node, no V8, no JavaScript engine in the binary)
